run_profile_game: run the profile_game script with a game JSON file to benchmark pydipcc processing performance per phase
create_pydipcc_game: create a pydipcc Game instance to simulate and process Diplomacy game phases from JSON data
set_orders_for_power: set orders for a specific power in the pydipcc game using game.set_orders(power, orders)
process_game_phase: process the current game phase in pydipcc by calling game.process() to resolve all orders
get_game_state: get the current game state including phase name by calling game.get_state() on a pydipcc Game
